label: Conversation · the turn manager
description: The isolated conversation & turn manager (conversation/): ear, inbox, manager, composer, ledger, effect gateway, mouth — its contracts, replays of recorded sessions as tokens, the seeded bombardment and the F0 tools

steps.label: The package owes the engine nothing (both directions)
Envelopes round-trip; unknown refused; authority fixed by kind
Every final word belongs to one intervention (I2)
One arbiter closes a turn (D1, A6)
Seal and substitution exclude each other (I1, I3)
The mailbox accounts for every envelope (I6)
Voice and chat share one order (X1-X10)
The policy table is total (D3)
Every request closes once (I9, N1)
Ledger transitions are the table
The prompt says each thing once
No code before the model picks a tool (I7)
Only an entry of the person grants authority (I8)
A confirmation handle is spent once (A4, N3, D8)
A hold before submission blocks it (A7)
The mouth knows what was heard
Three sentences reach the model whole
A numeric claim matches its evidence (D9)
A stale epoch writes nothing; the Store contract over both stores
P2: recorded sessions replay clean
Recorded fixtures carry no words
P3: random chunkings break no invariant (2,000 cases)
P8: a crash at any transition recovers
Every stage emits its event (§8)
F0 tools: the baseline counts a synthetic archive and the converter writes tokens only
